defect: Changing PasswordGeneratorWidget's base class from QWidget to QDialog makes it a top-level dialog, which breaks the standalone/embedded password generator in the main window.
reason: The fix reverts exactly this base-class change, saying QDialog breaks the standalone generator; seeing the breakage needs the places that embed the widget.

defect: The added 'static const CustomData::CustomDataItem NULL_ITEM;' default-initializes a const object of a type without a user-provided constructor, which AppleClang 7/8 reject as a compile error.
reason: The fix adds '{}' to this line, which the change added, to repair a build failure; the struct definition is in the header.

defect: The added 'static const Metadata::CustomIconData NULL_ICON;' default-initializes a const aggregate without an initializer, which AppleClang 7/8 reject.
reason: The fix adds '{}' to this line, which the change added, to fix the reported compile error; the struct is defined in Metadata.h.

defect: The new loose-comparison check '!url.contains(".")' rejects valid URLs whose host has no dot, such as https://myowndomain:8000.
reason: The fix removes exactly that condition and adds a test for a dotless host; the over-strict rule can be seen in the diff.

defect: The fix removes the MHD_is_feature_supported(MHD_FEATURE_IPv6) guard around the IPv6 setup, apparently so the code builds on the CI's libmicrohttpd, but which version lacks the call cannot be checked.
reason: The commit is a Travis CI setup fix with no stated error, and the repository does not show whether the guard broke the build or the fix is only a simplification.

defect: The new isEmpty() reads m_compUi->enterPasswordEdit even when the edit page was never set up (setupUi runs only in componentEditWidget), so it crashes when editing the master key.
reason: The fix guards isEmpty() with visiblePage() == Page::Edit to prevent the crash; the crash comes from callers that use isEmpty() before the edit page exists.

defect: The fix replaces the hard-wired OptionDialog page with a generic ISettingsPage/addSettingsPage mechanism and finishes wiring the HTTP plugin.
reason: The change was a work in progress that its author called probably broken, and the later commit is a redesign and completion of that feature rather than a repair of a specific defect in these lines.

defect: The new testClone uses QDateTime::setMSecsSinceEpoch, which exists only since Qt 4.7, so the tests fail to compile on the supported Qt 4.6.
reason: CMakeLists requires Qt >= 4.6.0, and the fix replaces the call with setTime_t; the minimum Qt version is in another file.

defect: The added currentDatabase->releaseData() calls on exit dereference a null QSharedPointer when no database is open, so the CLI crashes.
reason: The fix moves the release after the loop behind an if (currentDatabase) check; the prompt code in the same diff already shows currentDatabase can be null.

defect: The added setsockopt call passes an int* option value and has no Winsock include, so the code does not compile on Windows.
reason: The fix ("Regression occured in 3a92e4") adds the Winsock2 include and a char* cast to this line.

defect: The recent-databases list on the welcome screen is filled only once in the constructor (and opened only by double-click), so it stays stale after the history is cleared.
reason: The fix moves the filling into refreshLastDatabases(), calls it from MainWindow::clearLastDatabases, and switches to itemActivated; the stale-list defect lies in the change's one-time filling.

defect: removeIdentity is declared const in the header, but its definition is non-const and assigns m_error, so the declaration does not match the definition and the SSH agent build fails.
reason: The change edited only the header; the fix, titled "Fixed regression", removes the const, and the mismatch shows only in SSHAgent.cpp.

defect: m_countDefaultAttributes counts all menu actions including the separator, but the loop still starts at count + 1, so the first custom-attribute action is never deleted and entries pile up in the menu.
reason: The fix drops the + 1; you need the .ui file to see that the menu holds five actions plus a separator.

defect: disconnect(dbWidget, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr) removes every connection of each open DatabaseWidget, including the main window's, and not just the wizard's own.
reason: The fix restricts the disconnect to receiver 'this'; disconnecting with every argument as a wildcard is plainly too broad in the diff.

defect: The added toHtmlEscaped() calls on the edit-entry headline show HTML entities such as & literally, because the header QLabel renders that text as plain (auto-detected) text.
reason: The fix removes exactly these escapes; EditWidget's header label has no rich-text format set, which only that file shows.

defect: The change keeps setShortcut(actionDatabaseNew, QKeySequence::New, Ctrl+Shift+N), which uses the platform's standard New key (Ctrl+N), so New Database still gets Ctrl+N and clashes with the new entry shortcut Ctrl+N.
reason: The fix sets Ctrl+Shift+N directly and moves QKeySequence::New to the entry action; you need the setShortcut helper's semantics to see the problem.

defect: The new file includes "zxcvbn/zxcvbn.h", unlike the rest of the code base, which uses <zxcvbn.h>, so out-of-tree or system-zxcvbn builds fail.
reason: The fix changes this include to resolve build issue #3658; the include path setup is in src/CMakeLists.txt.

defect: The new context menu's updateGroupActions() only updates the delete action, so 'Add new group' and 'Edit group' stay enabled with no group selected or during search.
reason: The fix gives updateGroupActions a Group* parameter and sets all three group actions based on the group and search state; the faulty logic is in the change's DatabaseWidget.cpp.

defect: The new connect uses SLOT(updateAttachments()), which does not exist; the new function is updateSSHAgentAttachments(), so the connection fails at runtime and attachments do not update.
reason: The fix corrects the slot name, and the mismatch between the slot name and the function added in the same diff is visible.

defect: resetInAutoType() and the other paths unlock the new QMutex unconditionally, and the select dialog's rejected() can fire twice, so an unlocked mutex gets unlocked again (undefined behaviour).
reason: The fix restructures locking to make every unlock safe and blames double slot execution; the earlier bool-flag reset was harmless to repeat, so the defect is new, but the double signal can only be seen in the dialog code.
